findings: Three stable families; same large icons remain legible behind locks and after unlock.
Seven module pairs fit per row at desktop and tablet sizes; labels, symbols, frames and rune art do not overlap.
The outer and dialog bitmap frames preserve their source aspect ratios; safe content stays within their inner borders.
Filled/checkmarked stones, outlined next stone with plus and subdued future stones remain distinct with words hidden.
Comparison glyph is enlarged independently and remains proportionate to the adjacent numerals.
Hover and press move the entire surface together; pointer-out restores it.
Friendly fox remains a static portrait; only UI reward effects animate.
limitations: This is a review prototype; author approval and playtesting with children remain pending.
Module-to-family assignments and effect values are illustrative, not production balance.
Below 650 CSS px the full overview scrolls horizontally to preserve tablet-sized controls.
No production Phaser, Canvas/WebGL, save-system or real battle integration is asserted.
